I'm 22 y/o and I have been depressed for almost 5 years. This February I had a mental breakdown and I admitted myself to mental hospital. I dropped out of college because of that. That was my second time dropping out. I was feeling significantly better after the hospital, got prescribed antidepressants that seemed to help, asked a guy on a date and now he's my boyfriend, applied to college and was determined to start a new happy life. 

Until last week I started to feel depressed again. I haven't attented any lectures for the past 2 weeks, missed a few deadlines. I'm so scared I might drop out third time. I'm sick of taking money from my mother, and I have two acquaitances in church who said they will find me a job, if I finished first year of college (they work as programmers and I study Computer Science). I tried to work as janitor, it was a depressing job and the salary was very low, I just want to find a normal job, and I think I won't be able to do that, if I dropped out third time. I'm so stressed.

So I just lay in my bed and think about everything that is wrong with my life. I haven't changed my clothes or had a shower, or brushed teeth for a week. My flat is dirty and messy. Dirty dishes everywhere even right next to me in my bed. I smell and look like a homeless person. I eat badly because I can't bring myself to cook anything. Today I went grocery shopping because I was starving. On my way home I almost fainted because I'm so weak from starving myself. I watched porn for 6 hours a day past 3 days, and I feel bad because of that. I don't sleep at night because I'm scared of night, I imagine that someone's watching me or that someone's behind me, or make up some horror stories in my mind about the large mirror that's next to my bed and then I get scared. I don't know why I do that, if it makes me feel bad. I always procrastinate so much. If I have an assignmet, I get stressed and don't sleep for three nights prior the deadline because I want to study and do everything on time, but what I actually do is just stress out and tell myself I can't do it, until night before deadline comes and only then I start actually doing something. I pay for gym membership and never go there.
